hero.label: Hero / above the fold
hero.note: First screen: one clear promise, one primary CTA, product visible. Check how the headline names the outcome and where the CTA sits on mobile.

header.label: Announcement bar + header
header.note: Announcement bar carries the strongest offer (free shipping / COD / delivery promise). Compact header with search + cart always reachable.

mega-menu.label: Mega menu / mobile nav
mega-menu.note: Navigation that shops by need (category, concern, collection) with imagery - reduces hunting.

product-card.label: Product card / grid
product-card.note: Card shows image, price, rating/review count, badges (new, bestseller, % off) and often quick-add. Copy the information hierarchy.

category-tiles.label: Category tiles
category-tiles.note: Visual shortcuts into collections - lowers clicks to a product.

pdp.label: PDP - gallery + buy box
pdp.note: Above-the-fold product page: gallery, title, rating, price with savings, variant swatches / pack-size chips, primary add-to-cart.

pdp-details.label: PDP - details / accordions / trust
pdp-details.note: Below the buy box: benefits, accordions, delivery & returns, guarantees. Where objections get answered.

sticky-atc.label: Sticky add-to-cart (mobile)
sticky-atc.note: Mobile scroll state of the PDP - look for a sticky ATC / buy bar that keeps the CTA in reach.

reviews.label: Reviews / social proof
reviews.note: Review widgets, star summaries, UGC and testimonials - core trust builder.

footer.label: Footer
footer.note: Newsletter capture, policy links, payment/trust icons, social.

quiz.label: Quiz / product finder
quiz.note: Guided selling: quiz routes undecided shoppers to a product. Idea for 'find your guppy'.

bundle-builder.label: Bundle builder
bundle-builder.note: Build-a-bundle raises AOV. Maps to Pair / Trio / Starter tank kits.

cross-sell.label: Cross-sell / pair it with
cross-sell.note: Adds related products right where the decision happens.

brand-story.label: Brand story section
brand-story.note: Storytelling section that builds brand trust.

variant-selector.label: Variant / pack-size selector
variant-selector.note: Option chips/swatches near the price. Map to Pair / Trio / Group, male/female, strain colour.

cart-drawer.label: Cart drawer
cart-drawer.note: Slide-out cart after add-to-cart: look for a free-shipping/gift threshold bar, upsells and coupon nudges.

comparison.label: Comparison section
comparison.note: Us vs them / product comparison: answers 'why this one' objections.

brands.name: Imperial Tropicals
brands.why: PDP variant pills by size + sex: 0.5-1" Female / Male / Pair (1M,1F) / Trio (1M,2F). Pairs and trios are how hobbyists actually buy livebearers, and the dark hero puts a guppy on black under 'Buy directly from the breeder'. PDP section 'Our Healthy & Happy Arrival guarantee' ('packing and shipping live fish for over 50 years'), a FAQ entry 'How do you ship live fish? Sounds risky!', a Google-rating review wall on the PDP, and scientific names (Poecilia reticulata) on cards.

brands.name: Dan's Fish
brands.why: PDP 'Listing' buttons by sex and grade (Male-B Grade / Female-B Grade / Male / Female) beside a large photo, a thumbnail strip and an In-stock dot. The description is structured as Source / Estimated size at shipping / Adult size. Header marquee: Next Day Air $39.99 in the continental US 'no matter how many fish you buy'. PDP copy covers quarantine/medication protocols and a Certified Aquatic Veterinarian. Homepage has 'Choose the perfect pet', customer-success reviews and an embedded YouTube video.

brands.name: Aqua Huna
brands.why: Hero banner 'We offer 3-Day Live Arrival Guarantee / UPS Next Day Air Flat Rate $29.99' puts the trust promise first. Collection cards show live stock counts ('In stock, 60 units'). PDP: 'Sold in packs/multiples of 6', 'Individually priced', a 100% live arrival guarantee for Aqua Huna brand animals, 'For DOA refunds: Photo is required', 'Domestic shipping only... cannot ship to Hawaii & Washington State'. Availability/price filters.

brands.name: Flip Aquatics
brands.why: PDP with two variant pickers: Origin (Flip Bred / Imported) x Quantity (Juvie (Unsexed) / Male / Female / Pair (M/F)), plus a water-parameter list (pH 7.2-8.2, KH 4-6, GH 8-12, TDS 150-200, Temp 72-80) and a feeding/plant guide. Collection cards carry star ratings. '100% live-arrival guarantee when shipping with Overnight (1 day) option. All other options void our live arrival guarantee for fish.' Flat-rate FedEx Priority Overnight $34.99, free over $200 (announcement bar).

brands.name: Tropical Fish Co
brands.platform: Headless: Next.js front end; product images served from cdn.shopify.com, /products.json 404, so probably Shopify behind a custom storefront (not confirmed)
brands.why: Product cards that show care chips on every card (e.g. 22-28°C · pH 7-8 · 41L), plus PDP shoal-size price tiers (1 / 6 / 10 / 20 fish, 'Minimum healthy shoal') with a sticky Add-to-Basket bar. 'Live arrival guaranteed. If they don't arrive healthy, email us a short unboxing video the same day for a replacement or refund.' Oxygenated bags, insulation and heat packs; licensed live-animal courier; £19.95 tracked delivery (half price from £100, free from £200). Care Guide, Tank Mates / tank-mate checker, stocking calculator and an 'Ask Aqua' AI helper.

brands.name: Fishlist.sg
brands.why: PDP variant grid sex (MALE/FEMALE) x pack size (5pc/10pc/50pc), a free-shipping progress bar ('Free shipping for orders over $80.00') and Shop Pay. Collection cards have sale % badges and 'View options' buttons. 'Guaranteed Healthy on Arrival' tick on the PDP, short care requirements in the description ('Ensure compatibility with other tank mates'), and a homepage 'Collection list' with species tiles.

brands.name: guppie.au
brands.platform: No (no Shopify markers; custom stack behind Cloudflare)
brands.why: PDP 'Purchase Options' card with Pair (1M/1F) / Trio (1M/2F), a photo+video gallery, and 'Australia-wide shipping · Quality guaranteed' right under the CTA.
